flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui src/pages/NoticeSearch (page/upload/UploadResult.tsx, list/NoticeValidList.tsx, component/NoticeSearchUploadSlot.tsx), utils/mapping/NoticeSearch/NoticeSearch.ts (MapNoticeSeachExportXLSX), utils/data/SheetData.ts (HeaderAllNoticeDownload, HeaderOutsandingNoticeDownload), utils/function/FuncSheet.ts (SheetGenerate, XLSX in the browser). No appeal data from PLUS in the grid or the downloaded file
note: The story asks that the PLUS appeal check results for the uploaded summons/IDs are displayed on screen and downloadable, so the officer can decide whether to proceed with the house visit. The screen and download exist but their content does not hold the PLUS check result. The result page shows a notice grid and Download All / Download Selected buttons that build an XLSX file in the browser (NoticeSearchUploadSlot.tsx:60-80,102-124). But the downloaded file has no appeal data, the columns 'Summons No.' and 'Payment Date' are hardcoded '-' (SheetData.ts:562,596; NoticeSearch.ts:69), and the Payment Status export column maps every filled crsReasonOfSuspension value, including PP (Partially Paid), to 'Fully Paid' (SheetData.ts:575-578), unlike the screen which writes Partially Paid (column/index.tsx:270-283). The decision to proceed with the house visit is made manually by the officer; there is no house visit feature in the repos. The story status is blank, so the requirement is not given. No maintenance ticket is relevant to this download.
recommendation: Claim partially. Screen display and XLSX download exist, but without PLUS appeal results and with wrong/empty export columns. Fix the Payment Status and Summons No. mapping before claiming higher

steps.step: Hasil cek (pembayaran dan appeal PLUS) ditampilkan di layar
steps.detail: The upload result grid is shown on screen with row selection (UploadResult.tsx:64-76), holding payment status and suspension but not a PLUS appeal check result. Same as the show-on-screen step in OCMS34.18.

steps.step: Layar menampilkan data appeal dari PLUS (tanggal appeal, status, tanggal reply)
steps.detail: There is no date appealed, appeal status or reply date column in the grid. Same as the appeal data step in OCMS34.18.

steps.step: Officer meng-download salinan hasil dalam file
steps.detail: The Download All and Download Selected buttons build an XLSX in the browser through SheetGenerate (NoticeSearchUploadSlot.tsx:60-80,102-124). The file has no appeal data. The columns 'Summons No.' and 'Payment Date' are always '-' (SheetData.ts:562,596). Payment Status maps every filled crsReasonOfSuspension, including PP, to 'Fully Paid' (SheetData.ts:575-578), unlike the screen which writes Partially Paid. From reading the code; not executed.
